subject: Stan error message about INDEX OPERATOR [] OUT OF BOUNDS

messages.author: 8c97f108e3fc09d8
messages.subject: Stan error message about INDEX OPERATOR [] OUT OF BOUNDS
parts:
I got an error about the index, I see a some post  related to the similar problem in this group,but I  still don't know why and how to fix it. 


M1_code<-"
data{   #get the data we have
int <lower=0> N; #number of obs
int <lower=0> J; #number of gene level 
vector[N] y ; #y
vector[N] x; #x
int <lower=1> gene[N];
}
parameters{ #specify the parameter we want to know 
vector[J] a;  #random intercept when gene is the level 
real mu_a;  #mean for intercept
real <lower=0> sigma_a;  #variance of intercept
real <lower=0> sigma_y; #population variance
real beta;    #common slope;

}
transformed parameters{ #specify the model we will use 
vector[N] y_hat;
for (i in 1:N) 
     y_hat[i] <- a[gene[i]]+beta*x[i];#specify the group
}
model { #give the prior distribution 
  beta ~ normal(0,10);
  mu_a ~ normal(0,100);
  a ~ normal(mu_a, sigma_a);
  y ~ normal(y_hat, sigma_y); #y and y_hat should have same type 
}
"
N<-dim(table0)[1]   #N=200
J<-dim(table1)[1]   #J=12
gene<-as.numeric(table0$gene)
M1_table<-list(N=N, J=J, y=table0$envarpfc,
x=table0$envarp,gene=gene)

fit1<-stan(model_code=M1_code, data=M1_table,
                  iter=10000, chains=4)

The error is :
Informational Message: The current Metropolis proposal is about to be rejected because of the following issue:
INDEX OPERATOR [] OUT OF BOUNDS; index=13; lower bound=1; upper bound=12; index positioerror occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

p.s:  the gene level is 12.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Stan error message about INDEX OPERATOR [] OUT OF BOUNDS
parts:
I don't think that's going to land until we
update RStan past 2.6.0.

I'm guessing the problem is illegal gene[] values.
Try declaring

int <lower=1, upper=J> gene[N];

and see if that catches the issue during data initialization.
It looks like you're getting a 13, while J=12.

- Bob

Hi, Bob, 
Thank you for your email. But the reason is not this. Variable gene shows the name of gene .And there are 12  names of gene, so there are 12 levels of gene.  I use as.numeric( gene)  to make the character become numeric. And the range of as.numeric(gene)  is from 5 to 155.  I guess the reason for error is the range of as.numeric(gene) which is 5 to 155 is not same as 1 to 12.
